    ⟳ Regenerate card arts

    Use this when cards changed in the game but this app still shows old images or stats.

    1. If the Generated folder itself is stale, first re-export in Unity:
      Tools ▸ Cards ▸ Export All Cards as PNG (writes Assets/Generated/CardExports).
    2. Press the button below and pick your PataponCards project folder (repo root).
      Card stats (names, runes, legendary…) are re-read from the C# sources and every card PNG is re-imported.
    3. Afterwards press 💾 Save updated copy to keep the fresh art permanently in the app file.

    Import deck from text

    Paste a decklist exported by this app (or lines like 3x Yaripon / 2 Gong the Hawkeye).
